_doc: onboard.py capability: parse-report findings (kind:name) grouped into the mechanics an engine change implements, with a size each (S <= half a day, M ~1 day, L 2-3 days, XL a week or more). A finding no group lists is its own mechanic, sized by its kind. Estimated 2026-10-24 from the candidates' scripts (docs/open_vocab_plan.md S7); revise as mechanics land.
